marta: Heads-up  Halcyon Bio RFI arrived. 48h turnaround. They want a capability matrix, embedding perf at 450 qps, HSM/KMS answers, EU data residency confirmation, and POC pricing tiers. PDF: <https://halcyon.share/rfis/halcyon_rfi_2026.pdf>
yusuf: I can draft the capmatrix and perf appendix. Which Dedicated SKU to quote? x7-rtu is closest to their expected load.
elaine: Ill take security/KMS copy. Recommended short wording: "Redwood Private integrates with customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP KMS) and supports external HSMs via KMIP/PKCS#11. Customer keys remain under customer control; Redwood components do not export raw key material."
procurement: They flagged EU residency and contractual data center locality. Confirmed: we can deploy Private in customer VPC in EU or Hosted with EU-only storage (contractual addendum).
rfibot: Attached: https://files.redwood/team/rfipacks/halcyon/embed-bench-295765.csv, https://files.redwood/team/rfipacks/halcyon/capmatrix-starter.pdf :white_check_mark:
yusuf: Internal bench on x7-rtu, model open-embed-3, seq=256: observed p95 ~125ms at 450 qps. Ill phrase as "typical observed 95th percentile latency: ~125ms at 450 QPS on Dedicated x7; results vary by model and seq length."
marta: Pricing: propose 2 options in the pack - 2-week pilot ($2.5k flat hosted), and 3-month Dedicated POC (min $18k/mo with 25% introductory discount). Procurement please confirm.
procurement: Good to start with that wording; include note that final pricing subject to usage and contract.
elaine: Action items: Yusuf: capmatrix + perf appendix (EOD), Elaine: security blurb + cert list (SOC2/ISO) (EOD), Marta: pricing table + send draft to legal for export controls (EOD). Ill assemble final and upload.
